text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Art Dealer
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-san's paintings scorch the hearts of horse girls.
For they give shape to pure, unbridled passion.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Art Dealer
text_block_list.text: Her solo exhibition is sure to be magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes.
I'm sure Ramonu-sa—er, Ramonu will be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Art Dealer
text_block_list.text:
I hear you paint as well, Dober-san.
It would be fascinating if we could exhibit yours together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh, my paintings...?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Art Dealer
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it would draw great attention.
Seeing the contrast in art styles between two Mejiro horse girls...
It would be thoroughly intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, well...
I will... consider it positively.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
(Having my painting displayed...
This might be my chance to convey my feelings to Ramonu-san...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Oh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During a break in training, Mejiro Ramonu happened
to cast her gaze toward Mejiro Dober in the distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Their gazes entangle.
Yet Mejiro Dober does not look away,
returning Mejiro Ramonu's stare with unwavering focus.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu, what a fearsome child.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Ramonu's solo exhibition opened its doors.
In front of her paintings, a great crowd of horse girls
stood utterly captivated, yearning, drenched in euphoria.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Art Dealer
text_block_list.text:
It is a tremendous success, as anticipated.
I hope this serves as a wonderful occasion to make
Ramonu-san's beauty, majesty, and love known to the world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If it serves as kindling to feed the fire of racing,
then I am satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
U-Um!
I brought a painting... of my own too!
Would you please take a look at it...!?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Art Dealer
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You truly brought
one for us!?
Allow me to prepare a temporary display room at once!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —So this is your painting...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
It's my... painting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Very well.
Display it—in the central exhibition hall.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Art Dealer
text_block_list.text:
In the center, you say?
...No, understood.
I shall put it on display immediately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... Ramonu-san.
About the painting... well—!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: The title is—'Admiration'.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Little liar.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ! ...What do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Show me the rest of your works.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Next time—paint on the turf with your hoofprints,
and finish the canvas with cheers of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Enthrall me with your art
in the gallery of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
I will show you! Without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
In title alone, a puppy wagging its tail.
Yet what is depicted
—is a hound baring its fangs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
! I'm sorry...
But 'Admiration' isn't a lie!
I've always admired you, Ramonu-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Ever since the time you bit me—with those very fangs?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Within the serene gallery,
a fleeting scent of feral wildness drifted through the air.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My feelings haven't changed since back then.
...Will you please do a tandem training run with me?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl Art Dealer
text_block_list.text:
In anticipation of such a moment,
I have already secured a nearby training facility.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So she says. —What will you do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll go! Absolutely...!
Please let me join you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Let us run together—
my fierce, fearsome hound.
